finalText:
All 625 tests pass and `verify.js` confirms the fix.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:41` computed tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting its own doc comment ("tax is charged on the amount the customer pays"). Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents` — one-line change, suite went from 3 failing to 0.
